Fix: exclude .holyagent from the stop hook's dirty check, or have vcs commit carry the state (hooks doc, holyagent.md l.102).
2. Polling in the root's Bash instead of Monitor. Examples: d28f1a09 (18:42:37) `sleep 20; for i in $(seq 1 30)`; 51f6bfc2 (18:43:41) `sleep 15` then `seq 1 40`; b8613aae (18:44:24) `sleep 20`; 9789a12a (18:44:52). Cost is several minutes of wall time and repeated turns. Fix: Monitor with `gh pr checks <n> --watch` (holyagent.md l.124), then wait for the notice (l.27).
3. Built-in /code-review failed on `fatal: ambiguous argument 'origin/HEAD...'` (1793107579987, prefeitura-scripts review of a6830be). The reviewer fell back to a diff read and said it could not confirm the worktree commit. Fix: give reviewers an explicit base..head range in the brief, and do not depend on origin/HEAD.
